a.speaker: Thaw
a.text: Every freezer on the court has been dead since Day 0. On Day 2 the meat is still cold. By Day 4 it won't be. That's two deer, a side of beef and the Quans' entire freezer of dumplings.

options.text: Smoke, salt and can it, street-wide, in the Dunmores' driveway.
effects: Thaw: the street smoked and canned its freezers. Food-days +8.

options.text: Talk the court into one shared smokehouse and a share for everyone who brings meat.
Grill what you can tonight and let the rest go.

smoked.speaker: Thaw
smoked.text: Smoke hangs over the court for two days and every kid smells like a campfire. The cans line Ruth's garage shelves.

shared.speaker: Thaw
shared.text: Marisol and Hank build a smokehouse out of a garden shed and a woodstove. Everyone who brought meat gets a share.

half.speaker: Thaw
half.text: You lose half of it to spoilage, but half is something.

grill.speaker: Thaw
grill.text: A block party in a blackout. For one night it's almost a holiday. (Everyone -3 Strain.)

done.speaker: Thaw
done.text: The freezers stand open and empty in the driveways.
